description: DesignBuilder is a building performance analysis package from DesignBuilder Software Ltd for engineers, architects and energy assessors, presenting simulation engines in an easier interface. It is modular: a core 3D modeller plus 11 integrated modules, namely visualisation, simulation, daylighting, HVAC, cost and carbon, ASHRAE 90.1 and LEED, optimisation, scripting, CFD and certification, sold individually, as packages for architectural, engineering and other users, or as site network licences. User testimonials on the site describe EnergyPlus thermal simulation, Radiance daylighting and CFD analysis run from the same model, used for loads, sizing and energy analysis and in university teaching. Coverage: generic. Access: free 30-day trial, then annual licences bought online. Licence: commercial. Caveats: the engines named here come from user testimonials on the provider's pages, not a feature list, and prices did not render in the page text. Simulation uses: HVAC sizing, energy certification, daylighting and retrofit optimisation of individual buildings. Related records: EnergyPlus, OpenStudio, IES VE and Pollination.
